description: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API. A continuous series made by stitching the first hours of each forecast run. It tracks recent conditions. It is not the forecast that was issued a day ahead, and it is kept apart from the reanalysis files.
radiation_note: Open-Meteo shortwave, direct, diffuse and direct-normal values are the mean of the preceding hour. Temperature, humidity, cloud cover and wind are the value at the timestamp.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://open-meteo.com/en/licence).
note_sample: Small committed extract of one calendar month. Same columns as the full file, which is gitignored under data/raw or data/processed. start_date and end_date, when present, are the range of that full download.
